name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
notes: Scalar ALU and SFU work uses per-lane instruction-equivalents, not FLOPs. An FMA counts as one instruction.
GA10x has FP32-only lanes and FP32/INT32-capable lanes. fp32_int32 bounds their combined instruction demand; it is not an extra work category.
Tensor rates use dense FLOPs, with two FLOPs per multiply-accumulate. The selected tensor path is a model-wide setting.
Global-memory and shared-memory work counts logical payload bytes, not transactions.
L1 approximates the shared-memory path as 32 banks times 4 bytes per cycle per SM.
Rates omit dependency latency, issue limits, packing, occupancy, and instruction expansion unless approximated by configured work weights.
Utilization and launch_overhead_ms are calibration knobs, not hardware facts.
